name: Molten Gold Trap (CR 5)
body:
Molten Gold Trap
CR 5

XP 1,600

Type mechanical; Perception DC 20; Disable Device DC 25

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset automatic (immediate)

Effect shower of molten gold (2d6 bludgeoning damage plus 4d6 fire damage, DC 15 Reflex save for half damage); multiple targets (all targets in a 20-ft.-radius burst)
